Disruptive Tune.name: 擾神曲
Disruptive Tune.description:
一段擾亂心神的旋律短暫迴盪在以施法距離內你選擇的一點為中心、[[lookup @target.template.size activity=3Hl3sK9YjhjG6nnR]]呎半徑[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=3Hl3sK9YjhjG6nnR]]區域。區域內的每個生物都進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，目標失去&Reference[Concentration]{專注}，且在法術持續時間內為維持專注而進行的體質豁免具有劣勢。

Foundry 說明

在初始豁免失敗時，結束目標當前的專注並套用「擾神曲」主動效果。若此法術的專注提前結束，則移除該效果。

Raise Zombie.condition: At the start of your next turn after a Humanoid is killed by this spell
Raise Zombie.name: Raise Zombie

Negative Energy Flood.description:
You send ribbons of negative energy at one creature you can see within range. If the target isn’t Undead, it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking [[/damage]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a Zombie that follows your verbal orders for 24 hours, after which it acts according to its nature.

If the target is Undead, it gains [[/heal]].

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5.
Negative Energy Flood.name: Negative Energy Flood

Power Word Pain.name: Power Word Pain
Power Word Pain
Power Word Pain.description: The target is &Reference[Charmed apply=false]. Its Speed can be no more than 10 feet, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saving throws.

You speak a word of power that causes waves of intense pain to assail one creature you can see within range. If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it takes [[/damage activity=ac0OI2jWxjQy6Rji]] damage and has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. Otherwise, it takes 6d8 Force damage only.

While the target is Charmed, its Speed can be no more than 10 feet, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saving throws.

In addition, when the target tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn’t expended.

At the end of each of its turns, the Charmed target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a successful save.

Foundry Note

Apply the Power Word Pain active effect from Cast Spell only if the target has 100 HP or fewer. Use Spellcasting Save when the affected creature attempts to cast a spell and resolve a failure manually. Use Repeat Save at the end of each affected turn and remove the effect on a successful save.

Exhaustion.description: The target gains a level of &Reference[exhaustion apply=false].
Exhaustion.name: Exhaustion

Paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
Paralyzed.description: The target is &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition for the duration.

Vision of Elapsing Eons.name: Vision of Elapsing Eons
Vision of Elapsing Eons.description:
You trick a creature you can see within range into believing it is watching itself and its surroundings crumble away, as if eons were passing in moments. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take [[/damage]] damage and have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition for the duration.

While Paralyzed, the target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it gains 1 &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] level. On a successful save, the spell ends.

The spell ends early if someone within 5 feet of the target takes an action to shake it free from the illusion.

Festering Blast.description:
一道[[lookup @target.template.size activity=kpVaAawtqwUYnst5]]呎長、[[lookup @target.template.width activity=kpVaAawtqwUYnst5]]呎寬的[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=kpVaAawtqwUYnst5]]瘴氣自你的位置向你選擇的方向爆散而出。該直線區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗者承受[[/damage activity=kpVaAawtqwUYnst5]]傷害，且在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態。

因此法術而中毒的生物在其每個回合開始時承受[[/damage activity=RsCrFQCmliHaBpsa]]傷害。

中毒的目標在其每個回合結束時重複此豁免，豁免成功則結束此法術對其的影響。

【升環法術效應】你使用的法術位每比四環高一環，初始傷害便增加1d10。

Poisoned.name: 中毒
Poisoned.description: 目標陷入&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態，持續一分鐘。

Festering Blast.name: 潰爛爆發

Spirit Lantern.description: A ghostly black lantern hovers above you and sheds Dim Light in a 60-foot radius.
Spirit Lantern.name: Spirit Lantern

Ward Ally.name: Ward Ally
Ward Ally.description: Other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against this creature until the start of the caster's next turn.

Spirit Lantern.name: Spirit Lantern
Spirit Lantern.description:
You conjure a floating, ghostly black lantern that hovers above you and sheds Dim Light in a 60-foot radius. When an enemy dies within this Dim Light, a fragment of the creature’s soul flies into the lantern. The lantern can hold a number of soul fragments equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, and those fragments dissipate when the spell ends.

As a Bonus Action, you can expend a soul fragment to create one of the following effects.

Drain Life. The soul fragment darts at a creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to 4d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Repair Undead. The soul fragment flies into an Undead creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. That creature regains Hit Points equal to 4d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Ward Ally. The soul fragment darts around a creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the chosen creature until the start of your next turn.

Foundry Note

Capture Soul stores a soul fragment. The three Bonus Action activities automatically spend one. For Ward Ally, attackers select Disadvantage manually.

The Spent field for Limited Uses in the Details tab should be set to your Spellcasting Modifier to track that there are no souls currently captured.

Wither and Bloom.name: 靡葉生華
Wither and Bloom.description:
你以施法距離內的一點作為中心，在[[lookup @target.template.size activity=VuL7iUvj2gXAthhI]]呎半徑的[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=VuL7iUvj2gXAthhI]]區域裡喚起死氣與生機。該區域裡每個由你所選擇的生物都進行一次體質豁免，豁免失敗則受到[[/damage]]傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。區域裡並非生物的非魔法植物都會枯萎，例如樹木與灌木。

此外，區域裡一個由你所選擇的生物能擲一枚其未使用的生命骰，並恢復等同於擲骰結果加上你的施法屬性調整值的生命值。該骰子隨即被消耗。

【升環法術效應】。你使用的法術位每比二環高一環，其傷害便增加1d6。可投擲並消耗的生命骰數量每高一環也多1顆。無論擲多少顆生命骰，你的施法屬性調整值都僅在法術恢復的生命值中加上一次。

Exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
Exhaustion.description: The target gains a level of &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false].

Waves of Exhaustion.description:
You evoke a nimbus of flickering gray light around your body. For the duration, you can take a &Reference[Magic] action to emit a wave of gray light in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=GRYAmtjbmqTjVCtA]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=GRYAmtjbmqTjVCtA]]. Creatures in that area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain 1 &Reference[Exhaustion apply=false] level. This spell can’t increase a creature’s Exhaustion level above 4.

Exhaustion levels gained from this spell are removed when the spell ends.
Waves of Exhaustion.name: Waves of Exhaustion

Summon Plant.description:
You call forth the spirit of an animated plant. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Plant Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose @UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunSpiritFungudP]{Fungus}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunSpiritTreedl6]{Tree}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunSpiritVine5Yw]{Vine}. The creature resembles a plant of the chosen type, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

Foundry Note

For Spore Spray, apply the Poisoned effect if the target isn't already Poisoned. If it is already Poisoned, use the Already-Poisoned activity instead.
Summon Plant.name: Summon Plant

Invulnerability.name: Invulnerability
Invulnerability.description: You have Immunity to all damage until the spell ends.

Invulnerability.name: Invulnerability
Invulnerability.description: You have Immunity to all damage until the spell ends.

Zone of Amicability.name: 友善之域
Zone of Amicability.description: 在法術的發散區域內進行用於影響生物的屬性檢定時啟用此效果，檢定後停用。

Zone of Amicability.name: 友善之域
Zone of Amicability.description: 在法術持續時間內，你放射出一道60呎發散範圍的魔法友善之域。當你進行一次用於影響該區域內一名生物的屬性檢定時，你都可以將d20中擲出的9或更低的結果視為10。

Battle Familiar.name: 戰鬥魔寵
Battle Familiar.description:
你召喚出一隻充滿魔法力量的魔寵。該魔寵出現在施法距離內一處未佔據的空間；外貌類似你所選擇的一種動物，但生物類型為天界生物、妖精或邪魔（由你選擇），並且使用戰鬥魔寵數據卡。當你施放此法術時，選擇@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunBattleFamilXo]{蠻勇}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunBattleFamilbe]{掠空}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunBattleFamil2I]{潛獵}形態。該選擇將決定數據卡中的特定細節。

【戰鬥】該魔寵是你與你盟友的盟友。其擁有自己的先攻，並在自己的回合內行動。

【魔寵消失】戰鬥魔寵在法術結束、其生命值降至0，或你死亡時消失。當它消失時，其所穿著或攜帶的任何物品都會留在其原本所在空間。如果你再次施放此法術，你可以決定是召喚那隻已消失的魔寵，還是召喚一隻不同的魔寵。

【數量限制】。你同時擁有的魔寵數量上限為一。如果你已經擁有一個通過此法術召喚的魔寵，則舊的魔寵會被新的取代。

當你施放此法術時，如果你已經擁有一個來自尋獲魔寵法術的魔寵，你將強化你現有的魔寵，而不是召喚一個新的。在持續時間內，除了正常採取其他動作外，你的魔寵還可以進行攻擊，並且你魔寵的遊戲數據會被戰鬥魔寵數據卡所取代，但其保留其原本的生物類型、陣營、生命值、生命骰，以及尋獲魔寵法術賦予的任何特性。你的魔寵獲得數量等同於戰鬥魔寵生命值數值的臨時生命值。戰鬥魔寵法術在魔寵沒有剩餘臨時生命值時提前結束；而當戰鬥魔寵結束時，若仍有剩餘的臨時生命值，這些臨時生命值也會隨之消散。當戰鬥魔寵結束時，你的魔寵會變回原本的形態。

【升環法術效應】該生物的數據使用新的法術環階。

Foundry 說明

如果你已經擁有來自尋獲魔寵法術的魔寵，開啟其角色卡，將戰鬥魔寵Actor 拖曳至其上，並選擇變化變形設定檔。

Mordenkainen's Lucubration.description:
You recover up to two expended spell slots of level 2 or lower.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The maximum level of spell slots you can recover increases to level 3 (if cast with a level 6–7 spell slot) or level 4 (if cast with a level 8+ spell slot).

Foundry Note

After casting, use the eligible recovery activities up to two times total.
Mordenkainen's Lucubration.name: Mordenkainen's Lucubration

Enervation.name: Enervation
Enervation.description:
A tendril of inky darkness reaches out from you to drain life from a creature you can see within range.

The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes [[/damage activity=Wz1G6ehApCxRIGxV]] damage. On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a Bonus Action to deal [[/damage activity=nBroxslQNb4EYmwW]] damage to the target automatically. The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell’s range or it has &Reference[Total Cover] from you.

On a successful save, the target takes half the initial damage only, and the spell ends.

Whenever this spell deals damage to a target, you regain Hit Points equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The initial damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Foundry Note

After dealing damage, restore Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage actually dealt. Use Drain Life only against the original failed-save target. End Concentration if that target moves beyond 60 feet, gains Total Cover from you, or succeeds on the initial save.

Transfix.name: Transfix

Charmed & Incapacitated.name: Charmed & Incapacitated
Charmed & Incapacitated.description: This creature is &Reference[Charmed apply=false] and &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] for the duration.

Transfix.description:
For the duration, your appearance becomes otherworldly and alluring. One creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for the duration.

While Charmed, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition, and if the target is more than 5 feet away from you, it moves on its turn toward you by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of you. If the Charmed creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you, it takes [[/damage activity=8QrQ8SpPoosRKMPf]] damage.

The target doesn’t avoid &Reference[Opportunity Attacks] when moving toward you, but before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit), the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action on subsequent turns to target another creature, but you can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a save against this casting of the spell.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 7.

+20 Speed.description: 你的速度增加20呎，持續至你下一回合結束。
+20 Speed.name: 速度+20

Distorted Distance.name: 距離失真
Distorted Distance.description:
你創造出一種空間膨脹幻象，填滿以射程內一點為中心的[[lookup @target.template.size activity=HmKOEyhRsTbneToR]]呎半徑[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=HmKOEyhRsTbneToR]]區域。對於球型區域內你所能看見的每個生物，你可以對其選擇下列效應之一：

【天旋地轉】該生物進行一次智力豁免。若豁免失敗，則其受到[[/damage]]傷害，且球形區域對其而言視為&Reference[Difficult Terrain]{困難地形}，持續至其回合結束。

【縮地成吋】該生物的速度增加20呎，持續至其下一回合結束。

直到法術結束前，每當一名生物進入球型區域或在其中結束回合，你都可以選擇使其受到這些效應之一。一名生物每回合只能受到一次此法術的影響。

Foundry 說明

當生物進入球型區域或在其中結束回合時，使用對應的後續活動。每名生物每回合只能受影響一次。天旋地轉豁免失敗後，將球型區域視為該生物的困難地形，持續至其回合結束。

Moment of Prescience.name: Moment of Prescience
Moment of Prescience.description: You have a powerful sixth sense that guides you at just the right time. Turn the roll of your failed D20 Test into a 20, or turn the roll of the triggering attack roll into a 1.

Reweave Fate.name: Reweave Fate
Reweave Fate.description: You untangle a single thread of fate to encourage a different result. The creature that failed the D20 Test can reroll it with Advantage, and the creature must use the new roll. If the D20 Test is successful, the creature gains [[/healing]] from its strengthened fate.

Fractured Awareness.name: Fractured Awareness
Fractured Awareness.description:
You cause a creature to receive conflicting visions of multiple possible futures. Choose a creature you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes [[/damage activity=m2QWVW3rdHdJpslk]] damage and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests for the duration. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only, and the spell ends.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the save, ending the spell on a success.

Disadv. D20 Tests.name: Disadv. D20 Tests
Disadv. D20 Tests.description: Conflicting visions disrupt the target's ability to act decisively, imposing Disadvantage on their D20 Tests.

Aura of Evasion.name: Aura of Evasion
Aura of Evasion.description:
An aura of alacrity radiates from you in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=icBZdq2WvMCsaopA]]-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. When an affected creature is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. A creature with the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition doesn’t gain any benefit from being in the aura.

Foundry Note

When a creature benefiting from this aura makes a Dexterity save against an effect that normally deals half damage on a success, apply 0 damage on a successful save or half damage on a failed save. If the creature is Incapacitated, resolve the damage normally.

Uncertain Footing.description:
你創造出諸如岩石或地刺般的障礙物幻象，嘗試干擾至多三名施法距離內你所能看見的生物，影響其移動能力。

每名目標進行一次智力豁免。豁免失敗時，目標的速度減半，且無法採取&Reference[Dash]{疾走}動作。受妨害的目標在其每個回合結束時重複此豁免，若豁免成功，則其身上的該法術終止。

Hampered.description: 該生物的速度減半，且無法採取&Reference[Dash]{疾走}動作。
Hampered.name: 受妨害

Uncertain Footing.name: 步履維艱

Unconscious.description: 你在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[Unconscious]{昏迷}狀態。
Unconscious.name: 昏迷

Catnap.description:
你做出一個安撫的手勢，隨後，射程內至多三名你所選且能看見的自願生物在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[Unconscious apply=false]{昏迷}狀態。

若目標承受傷害，或有其他生物採取動作將其搖醒，則目標身上的法術提前終止。

若一名目標因此法術而在整個持續時間內都具有昏迷狀態，則該目標獲得完成一次&Reference[Short Rest]{短休}的好處，且在完成一次&Reference[Long Rest]{長休}前不能再受到此法術的影響。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，你就可以額外指定一名自願生物作為目標。

Foundry 說明

若目標受到傷害或被搖醒，請提前移除昏迷效果。
Catnap.name: 假寐術

Dueling Ground.description:
你創造出一個由發光符文法陣所框定的魔法決鬥場地，其以你所觸碰的地面上一點為中心的[[lookup @target.template.size activity=xCrhehapHurs0qGo]]呎半徑[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=xCrhehapHurs0qGo]]區域。

作為創造此決鬥場的一部分，你指定兩名位於球狀區域中的自願生物作為目標。若除了這兩名目標之外的任何生物進入球狀區域，則法術提前終止。

若一名目標在身處決鬥場地期間生命值降至0，則目標傷勢穩定，並傳送至距其最近且位於決鬥場外的未佔據空間。若一名目標在身處決鬥場期間，受到某種不造成傷害卻能夠立即將其殺死的效應影響，則目標不會死亡，轉而具有0生命值並陷入昏迷狀態，傷勢穩定，並傳送至距其最近且位於決鬥場外的未佔據空間。

當只有一名目標位於決鬥場地中時，與球狀區域周圍地面上相對應的符文會短暫地在那名目標的頭頂閃爍，如同一頂冠冕。

【升環法術效應】你使用的法術位每比二環高一環，你就可以額外指定一名自願生物作為目標。

Foundry 說明

為每名被指定的決鬥者套用標記決鬥場地目標主動效果。若有其他生物進入球狀區域，結束法術並移除這些效果。當決鬥者的生命值降至0或透過此法術避免立即死亡時，處理其傷勢穩定狀態並將其 Token 移動至球狀區域外最近的未佔據空間。
Dueling Ground.name: 決鬥場

Detonate.description:
You create a magical, explosive seed inside a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=gzd1pO9UqWXZQjmv]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

An explosion then originates from the target. Each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the target (not including the target) makes a Dexterity saving throw, with Disadvantage if this spell reduced the target to 0 Hit Points. A creature takes [[/damage average activity=d6Ijp0rgJgYpV8gc]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A nonmagical object that isn’t being worn or carried also takes the damage if it’s in the Emanation, and the object starts burning if it’s flammable.
Detonate.name: Detonate

Iron Body.description: One willing creature you touch transforms into living metal. Until the spell ends, the target’s Exhaustion level can’t increase; the target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Fire, Piercing, and Slashing damage; and it has Immunity to Poison damage and the Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions. If the target is Paralyzed, Petrified, or Poisoned when you cast the spell, those conditions immediately end for the target.
Iron Body.name: Iron Body

Iron Body.description: The creature has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Fire, Piercing, and Slashing damage; Immunity to Poison damage; and Immunity to the Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
Iron Body.name: Iron Body

Hindsight.description: You peer backward through the fabric of time. You see visions of events that occurred within range throughout the past 10 years, racing by at approximately 1 day per second. Throughout the spell’s duration, you can freely slow down, pause, rewind, or fast-forward through these visions.
Hindsight.name: Hindsight

Grave Ground Save.condition: When an enemy enters the area or ends its turn there
Grave Ground Save.name: Grave Ground Save

-1d6 Damage Penalty.name: -1d6 Damage Penalty
-1d6 Damage Penalty.description: Skeletal hands sap the creature's strength. It subtracts 1d6 from its damage rolls until the end of its next turn.

Grave Ground.name: Grave Ground
Grave Ground.description:
Skeletal hands burst from an area on the ground within range. The area consists of up to four [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8aJnPEZ0nttU2jdh]]-foot [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=8aJnPEZ0nttU2jdh]]s, which you arrange as you like. Each square must be contiguous with at least one other square. That area is &Reference[Difficult Terrain] for your enemies.

Any enemy in that area when the skeletal hands appear makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/damage activity=8aJnPEZ0nttU2jdh]], and until the end of its next turn, the creature subtracts 1d6 from all its damage rolls. An enemy also makes this save if it enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

Foundry Note

Place the four square templates so each touches at least one other square; Foundry does not enforce contiguous placement.

Summon Dinosaur.description:
You call forth the spirit of a primeval dinosaur. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Dinosaur Spirit stat block.

When you cast the spell, choose Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur. The creature resembles a dinosaur of the chosen type, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, the creature takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.
Summon Dinosaur.name: Summon Dinosaur

Lightning Ring.description:
A ring of crackling electricity fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=9EPd4oDGoMGLtdrA]]-foot Emanation originating from you.

Whenever the Emanation enters a creature’s space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes [[/damage activity=Yhx2AFaGBY6MwU7K]] damage, and it has the &Reference[Deafened apply=false] condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

As a &Reference[Magic] action while the spell is active, you can emit a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=shTMZl9XHsTOkcmx]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=shTMZl9XHsTOkcmx]]-foot-wide [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=shTMZl9XHsTOkcmx]] out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking [[/damage activity=shTMZl9XHsTOkcmx]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Deafened.name: Deafened
Deafened.description: The target is &Reference[deafened apply=false] for one minute.

Emanation Save.condition: When the Emanation enters a creature's space, or a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there
Emanation Save.name: Emanation Save

Lightning Ring.name: Lightning Ring

Illusory Dragon.description:
By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The illusion lasts for the spell’s duration and occupies its space as if it were a creature. The illusion is tangible because of the shadow material used to create it but has Immunity to all damage and conditions.

When the illusion appears, any enemy that can see it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature drops whatever it’s holding and has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition for the duration. If a creature Frightened in this way ends its turn in a space where it doesn’t have line of sight to the illusion, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point during its movement, you can cause the shadowy dragon to exhale a blast of energy in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 6d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage (your choice when you create the dragon) on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature that takes a &Reference[Study] action to examine the dragon can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image and has Advantage on saving throws to end the Frightened condition it caused and to resist its exhalation.

Foundry Note

Players casting this spell need the Allow Summoning and Create Tokens permissions enabled. On first use, the linked dragon Actor may also need to be imported from the compendium by a GM if the player cannot create Actors.
Illusory Dragon.name: Illusory Dragon

Disadv. D20 Tests.name: D20檢定劣勢
Disadv. D20 Tests.description: 該生物進行的D20檢定具有劣勢。

Inflict Doubt.name: 賦予懷疑
Inflict Doubt.description: 你向射程內一名你所能看見的生物植入自我懷疑。目標必須通過一次感知豁免，否則在法術持續時間內進行的&Reference[D20 Test]{D20檢定}具有劣勢。目標在其每個回合結束時重複此豁免，若豁免成功則結束此法術對其的影響。

Entrancing Mirrors.description:
You create dozens of illusory mirrors to confuse up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

Each target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes [[/damage activity=NBsNZGWCtKk5Bbc4]] damage and has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition. While the target is Stunned, its Speed is halved. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

A Stunned target repeats the Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
Entrancing Mirrors.name: Entrancing Mirrors

Stunned.name: Stunned
Stunned.description: You have the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition. While Stunned by this spell, your Speed is halved.

Deafened.name: Deafened
Deafened.description: The target is &Reference[Deafened apply=false] condition for 1 hour.

Wail of the Banshee.description:
You emit a terrible scream that can kill those who hear it.

Choose up to ten creatures within range. Each target with 50 Hit Points or fewer dies. Targets with more than 50 Hit Points make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes [[/damage]] damage and has the &Reference[Deafened apply=false] condition for 1 hour. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

A target is unaffected by the spell if it can’t hear you.
Wail of the Banshee.name: Wail of the Banshee
